operations.command: set -e; lsblk -dno NAME | grep -q '^nvme0n1$' && printf nvme-present

set -e; iptables -A OUTPUT -p tcp --syn -j REJECT; iptables -A OUTPUT -p udp --dport 53 -j REJECT; if timeout 20 curl -sSI https://cache.nixos.org >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo reachable; exit 1; fi; printf network-cut

set -e; grep -q 'installing the system baked into this installer' /tmp/install.log; if grep -q 'github:nix-community/disko' /tmp/install.log; then echo fetched-disko; exit 1; fi; if grep -qE 'will be built|copying path .* from .https' /tmp/install.log; then echo built-or-fetched; exit 1; fi; printf used-prebuilt

listing=$(btrfs subvolume list -a /mnt); echo '--- subvolumes after install ---'; echo "$listing" | grep -F '@snapshots' || echo '(no @snapshots entries)'; missing=0; for volume in @root @home; do echo "$listing" | grep -qE "@snapshots/$volume/CLEAN\$" || { echo "MISSING published CLEAN for $volume"; missing=1; }; done; echo "$listing" | grep -qF 'CLEAN.tmp.' && { echo 'LEFTOVER CLEAN temporary present'; missing=1; }; [ "$missing" -eq 0 ] && printf clean-published || printf clean-broken

if [ "{{assertPanel}}" != "true" ]; then echo "panel pixels not asserted for this agent (a plymouth splash is mostly black too)"; printf panel-graphical; else python3 tests/hosts-boot/assert_panel.py '.vm/e2e/{{state}}-{{stateHashShort}}/panel-0.ppm'; fi

timeout 900 bash -c 'until grep -qa E2E-HIBERNATING ".vm/e2e/{{state}}-{{stateHashShort}}/serial.log"; do sleep 5; done' || { echo 'never hibernated'; tail -c 1500 ".vm/e2e/{{state}}-{{stateHashShort}}/serial.log"; exit 1; }; printf hibernated

if [ "{{assertPanel}}" != "true" ]; then echo "panel pixels not asserted for this agent (a plymouth splash is mostly black too)"; printf panel-graphical; else python3 tests/hosts-boot/assert_panel.py '.vm/e2e/{{state}}-{{stateHashShort}}/panel-1.ppm'; fi
grep -qa 'E2E-RESUMED yes' ".vm/e2e/{{state}}-{{stateHashShort}}/boot-1.log" && printf resumed || { echo 'resume marker missing'; exit 1; }

if [ "{{assertPanel}}" != "true" ]; then echo "panel pixels not asserted for this agent (a plymouth splash is mostly black too)"; printf panel-graphical; else python3 tests/hosts-boot/assert_panel.py '.vm/e2e/{{state}}-{{stateHashShort}}/panel-2.ppm'; fi

for b in 0 2; do grep -aE '^E2E-(STATE|FAILED|REFUSED|HOMEMANAGER|SNAPSHOTS|SWAP|UNLOCKAGENT)' ".vm/e2e/{{state}}-{{stateHashShort}}/boot-$b.log" | sed -E 's/^(E2E-UNLOCKAGENT [a-z0-9]+).*/\\1/' | sort > ".vm/e2e/{{state}}-{{stateHashShort}}/norm-$b.txt"; done; diff ".vm/e2e/{{state}}-{{stateHashShort}}/norm-0.txt" ".vm/e2e/{{state}}-{{stateHashShort}}/norm-2.txt" > /dev/null && printf boots-identical || { echo 'boots differ'; diff ".vm/e2e/{{state}}-{{stateHashShort}}/norm-0.txt" ".vm/e2e/{{state}}-{{stateHashShort}}/norm-2.txt"; exit 1; }
